title: GSW injury report: Gui Santos, Al Horford and more ahead of game vs. Suns
text:
Warriors injury report: Gui Santos, Al Horford and more Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter WARRIORS GSW injury report: Gui Santos, Al Horford and more ahead of game vs. Suns
 While Stephen Curry and Draymond Green are back, the Warriors will be without Gui Santos and Al Horford against the Suns.
 Mack Baltes Warriors Wire Nov. 2, 2026, 4:20 p.m. PT The Golden State Warriors will face the Phoenix Suns on Monday night.
 Stephen Curry and Draymond Green are expected to return for the Warriors after resting Sunday.
 The Suns previously defeated the Warriors earlier this season when Golden State was shorthanded.
 The Golden State Warriors face the Phoenix Suns on the second night of a back-to-back Monday, having defeated the Los Angeles Clippers Sunday night without two of their biggest contributors, two-time MVP Stephen Curry and former Defensive Player of the Year Award winner Draymond Green.
 According to Warriors insider Anthony Slater, both Curry and Green will be available for Monday's game after resting Sunday. Former NBA champion Al Horford has been ruled out in addition to Gui Santos, who had been playing through knee tendinitis. Backup point guard Brandon Williams is listed as questionable due to a quad contusion. For Phoenix, they are completely healthy, besides center Mark Williams, who has yet to make his 2026-27 season debut, recovering from a torn labrum.
 When these two teams met earlier this season, Phoenix earned the win on their home floor, 131-122. That said, Golden State was without the aforementioned duo of Curry and Green as well as Brandon Podziemski.
